'''2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Hoth North Ridge region (Alaska, Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Saskatchewan, Yukon) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00hothnorthridge">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=hothnorthridge 2000 Regionals: Hoth North Ridge], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727140917/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=hothnorthridge Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Alan Sagan]] of Kamloops, British Columbia won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 5 August 2000
* '''Site:''' The Sentry Box 1835-10th Ave SW Calgary, Alberta Canada
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Ian Pownall]]
